events.name: NRL Grand Final
events.selectedSentence: Brisbane's absence guarantees a new champion at Accor Stadium, with the first-time Dolphins and title-seeking Warriors inside the locked eight.
events.fullSpiel: The 4 October decider will crown a different champion after reigning premier Brisbane missed the finals. The Dolphins have made the eight for the first time, South Sydney is back for the first time since 2022, and the Warriors are still chasing the club's first premiership after Grand Final defeats in 2002 and 2011.
